Name: (CP) Dino Rancher
Author: lichm
Description:
DINOS ARE CUTE BUT THEY NEED TO BE MORE COMPETITIVE WITH CHICKENS! 
EVEN AFTER THE BLESSING OF THE TREASURE APPRAISAL GUIDE, DINOS STILL LAG TOO FAR BEHIND!
RISE UP RANCHERS! FARM THOSE DINOS!

Quick testing did not find any errors with Laying, Incubating, or Donating, and Rancher combined properly with the Treasure Appraisal Guide.

Balance-wise, this still might average a little below chickens/mayo, due to quality variance, but it'll be close, [i]and that's all I'm asking for.[/i]

Honestly, It's a little baffling that this is not in the game. I wonder if CA's planning document applied this, but it never made it to the game, and that's why Dino's profit has sucked so bad?

First mod ever, so be kind!
